====================================
Topology Documentation
====================================

``topology`` is a Python library for working with molecular topology,
connectivity, structural organization, and related analysis tools.

This documentation provides:

* Installation instructions
* Usage examples
* API reference (auto-generated)
* Example-driven workflows
* Change history
